title: Filter weekly dashboard — Zendesk-linked Escape Defects and Support Requests

jql.created: project = FILTER AND issuetype in ("Escape Defect", "Support Request") AND "Zendesk Ticket Count" > 0 AND created >= "2026-08-01" ORDER BY created ASC
jql.created_open: project = FILTER AND issuetype in ("Escape Defect", "Support Request") AND "Zendesk Ticket Count" > 0 AND created >= "2026-08-01" AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY created ASC
jql.created_done: project = FILTER AND issuetype in ("Escape Defect", "Support Request") AND "Zendesk Ticket Count" > 0 AND created >= "2026-08-01" AND statusCategory = Done ORDER BY created ASC
jql.resolved: project = FILTER AND issuetype in ("Escape Defect", "Support Request") AND "Zendesk Ticket Count" > 0 AND resolved >= "2026-08-01" ORDER BY resolved ASC
